title: SMS Delivery Failures from Twilio to Telemat Cel Brazil
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery failures from Twilio to Telemat Cel network subscribers in Brazil. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 8 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.
backbase_rationale: The outage could affect SMS communications for Backbase users.

title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe Martinique
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe network subscribers in Martinique. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 1 hour or as soon as more information becomes available.
backbase_rationale: The delays could impact timely message delivery for Backbase clients.

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: The removal of the Send to Coworker action eliminates an option in the domain authentication setup flow.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must ensure its domain authentication workflows remain functional and secure.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.18.0
impact_summary: The SDK now requires a minimum Android API level of 24, which may break support for apps targeting older Android versions.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must update the integration to target API 24 or later to remain functional.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.14.0
impact_summary: Accessibility updates for compliance with WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA standards have been introduced.
backbase_rationale: Backbase should verify that its user interface meets the new accessibility standards.
